articles.title: From Phantom to Heist: Andrew Lloyd Webber's Next Musical Is the Wild True Story of the Mona Lisa's Theft
articles.summary: In 1911, a Louvre worker walked out with the Mona Lisa hidden under his smock. The painting was missing for two years. Now Andrew Lloyd Webber is turning this bizarre true-crime art heist into a musical.

articles.title: Retiring at 36, Sorana Cirstea Just Made History with a 'Double Bagel' at the French Open
articles.summary: Romania's Sorana Cirstea, 36, crushed Solana Sierra 6-0, 6-0 to become the oldest player in the Open era to record a double bagel in a Grand Slam main draw. She plans to retire at the end of 2026.

articles.title: 'The Punk Rockers': A Photo of Spiky Egret Chicks Wins Smithsonian's Top Prize
articles.summary: Three egret chicks with unruly, spiked feathers—looking like tiny mohawked rebels—won the grand prize in Smithsonian Magazine's 23rd annual photo contest. The image beat 17,000 entries from 108 countries.
